tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Wall: page background of every screen and of the room behind the posters.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Shelves, panels, dialogs and inputs raised above the wall.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fills, skeletons, the cover slot while an image loads.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-100, surface-200, surface-300 and brand-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (slug, counts, sync status) on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, links, selected state. Passes as text on surface-100 and surface-200 in every theme.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Soft brand background (selected item, limit upsell). Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The lamp: Agora marker, premium badges, decorative fills. A fill only, never text on a surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an accent fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Synced and saved states as text or icon on surface-100 and surface-200. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed sync, destructive actions as text, icon or border on surface-100 and surface-200. Always paired with a word; success and danger are close in lightness.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and the wall rail. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes (3:1 on surfaces).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every surface.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: Masking tape that holds posters and the avatar photo. Decoration, carries no text.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Handwritten note slips and the photo frame of the avatar. Same light value in dark themes on purpose.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Handwritten text on paper (hand family only, 4.5:1 on paper).

tokens.name: on-sticker
tokens.usage: Text and icons on every category sticker.

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Posters, covers, stickers, paper slips: media is nearly square-cornered like printed paper.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Only for round things (the pin, the avatar ring). Not for labels or chips.

tilt.note: Resting angle of media objects. Each item gets a factor in [-1,1] derived from its id; angle = factor * tilt-max, with magnitude never below tilt-min. In a grid narrower than 480px the angle is multiplied by tilt-mobile-scale.

tokens.name: tilt-max
tokens.usage: Largest resting angle of a media object, either direction.

tokens.name: tilt-min
tokens.usage: Smallest angle magnitude, so no object looks accidentally flat.

tokens.name: tilt-mobile-scale
tokens.usage: Multiplier on the angle in grids narrower than 480px (0.5deg to 1.5deg).

tokens.name: shadow-poster
tokens.usage: Printed things resting on the wall: posters, volumes, sleeves, polaroid.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Panels on the wall.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered items, dialogs and toasts.
